Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: MySellingMate is built to respect your privacy. This policy explains what we process, why, and the choices you have.
Privacy.body:
What we process
When you scan an item, the photos you take leave the device so we can identify the object and estimate its resale price. We send only the photos and the item details those two tasks need.

How the processing works
Your photos do not go straight to the AI providers. They go first to our backend, a Firebase Cloud Function operated by Google, which forwards them to OpenAI and to Perplexity. Google therefore processes your photos and item details on our behalf. That function runs in Google's europe-west1 region, so this part of the processing stays in the European Union.

The AI providers
OpenAI identifies the item and Perplexity researches the price. They process your photos and item details solely to return that result to the app, and their handling of the data is governed by their own terms and privacy policies. We do not use your photos to train our own models.

The anonymous identifier
Each installation of the app gets an anonymous identifier from Firebase Authentication. Our backend uses it to check that a request really comes from the app and not from somewhere else. It is not an account: the identifier itself carries no personal details, and we do not connect it to your name, your email address or any other contact detail. Firebase Authentication is not a regional service, so that identifier is transferred to the United States. Your photos are not. The image processing itself stays in europe-west1.

Where your data lives
Your scan history and the photos you keep are stored on your iPhone. We do not host your library on our servers. There is no account to create, and we do not track you across apps or run advertising analytics.

Your choices
You can delete any scan, or wipe everything at once, from inside the app at any time. Deleting your data also clears the related photos from your device. Because your history lives on your device, removing the app removes your data with it.

Contact
Questions about privacy? Write to support@myellelab.com.

Terms.title: Terms of Use
Terms.intro: By using MySellingMate, you agree to these terms. Please read them, they are short.
Terms.body:
The service
MySellingMate identifies second hand items from photos, estimates an indicative resale price, and suggests where to sell. It is a helper tool, not a broker, and it does not buy, sell, or handle transactions.

Price estimates are indicative
Every price is an estimate, not a guaranteed selling price and not a formal appraisal. Estimates come from comparable listings and public retail prices, and they can be wrong or out of date. Always do your own check and set your own price before listing anything.

AI processing
Identification and pricing rely on third party AI providers, OpenAI and Perplexity. Your scans reach them through our own backend, a Firebase Cloud Function operated by Google. AI can misidentify items or misjudge value. You are responsible for verifying results before you act on them.

Acceptable use
Use the app for lawful resale of items you own. Do not use it to value illegal, counterfeit, or prohibited goods.

Liability
MySellingMate is provided as is, without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for losses arising from decisions you make based on the app, including sale prices or platform choices.

Changes
We may update these terms as the app evolves. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

Contact
Questions? Write to support@myellelab.com.

Support.responseNote: We usually reply within a couple of business days.
Support.faq1Q: How accurate are the price estimates?
Support.faq1A: Estimates are indicative. We base them on comparable used listings and, when those are scarce, on the current retail price adjusted for condition. Always set your own final price.
Support.faq2A: Your scan history and photos stay on your iPhone. To identify the item and estimate its price, photos go to our backend, which runs in the EU, and from there to our AI providers.
